accepted.reason: Figma set o'ramasi (specimen) foni — komponentning o'zi emas; kodda chart ota kartochkada (ChartCard) turadi.

Figma tavsifi va doc (Anatomy 3) kataklarni sequential 200 · 300 · 600 · 700 deb belgilaydi (CMP-07), lekin namunadagi ma'lumotda 40–70% ulushli katak yo'q — shuning uchun 600 spec'ga tushmagan. Figma'da namunaga 600 darajali katak (masalan, 55%) qo'shilishi kerak.
